text: Annabi Ibraahiima maaki: anndee ko rewoton kon gaanin Alla, ko sanamuuji, ɗi rewirton, fii yiɗindirgol hakkunde mon, ka nguurndam aduna. Hooti non, Ñalnde Darngal, ngol giggol taƴoyay hakkunde mon, woɗɓe e mon yeddoya ɓeya, tuma lepte ɗen feeñata, ɓeya kadi huɗoya ɓeya, hara non, jaaƴorde mon on fow, ko ka Yiite, ka on alaa wallooɓe e ɗen lepte Alla, gile e sanamuuji mon ɗi rewaynoɗon ɗin, wanaa fere goɗɗum goo.
